annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people are about to be hit and moving a lever costs nobody anything
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Just picturing that train reaching them makes my chest tighten.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: If I froze and they got hurt, I'd carry that for a long time.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: whoever parked it should have set the brakes properly or chocked the wheels

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Nobody gets hurt on the siding, and five lives are on the line.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I can feel my stomach drop just imagining those workers
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd be sick with regret afterward, because I could have stopped it.
annotations.pda_responsibility: because I could have stopped it
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the station should have had a derail device or an alarm on that track

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Watching people get crushed when I could prevent it would leave me shaking.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: someone was hit because of that, I'd go over it again and again
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Whoever's in charge of maintenance scheduling probably should have posted a lookout

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The siding is empty, the barrier stops the train, so I'd pull.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: the thought of those five on the track, it makes my hands go cold
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd hate myself if my slowness cost any of them.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: a proper handbrake check at shutdown would have prevented all this

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Saving five people at no cost to anyone is just the decent thing.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Even seeing them in danger would rattle me, my heart would be pounding.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: If I didn't act and someone died, that regret wouldn't fade.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the rail company should have locked that switch to the siding by default

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: people's lives matter more than my staying out of it
annotations.pd_harm_distress: Thinking about the workers being struck makes me feel a little queasy
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret it deeply if I let the moment slip and they were injured
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: a supervisor probably should have radioed the crew

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Nothing bad happens on the siding and five people keep their lives.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: My throat tightens just picturing the impact.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: if they got hurt while I dithered, I'd regret it for years
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the yard staff should have parked that train on level track with the brakes tested

annotations.pd_harm_distress: Imagining those workers being hit is upsetting enough that I'd probably feel it
annotations.pda_harm_regret: Had I held back and one of them got hurt, I'd have trouble forgiving myself.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the maintenance crew's foreman should have insisted on warning lights or a horn

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Letting five people be hurt when I can stop it without harming anyone
annotations.pd_harm_distress: The idea of seeing them struck makes me uneasy in a way that sits heavy.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: If my delay led to even one injury, I'd regret that deeply.
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the track manager probably should have kept that siding switch set by default

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: It saves five people and costs nothing.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: watching a train bear down on them would leave me shaken, my pulse racing
annotations.pda_harm_regret: if I'd stood still and they'd been hurt, I would keep replaying my failure
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: whoever last handled that train should have applied the brakes and reported it
